## <a:Loadouts:1535779248982335618> **Gunsmith Commands**
-# **Usage: `/cmd <required> [optional]`**

### `/gunsmiths search`
Find a specific MP weapon's loadout
-# **Options**
-# 🔹 `<weapon>` Select weapon (supports autocomplete & partial word matching)
-# 🔹 `[build]` Specify build number
-# 🔹 `[visibility]` Show this response only to you, or publicly to everyone in the chat.
### `/gunsmiths list`
Browse a whole set of builds -- a weapon category, all MP builds, Meta (MP or DMZ), or DMZ
-# **Options**
-# 🔹 `<scope>` Pick what to browse
-# 🔹 `[visibility]` Show this response only to you, or publicly to everyone in the chat.
### `/dmz`
Search for DMZ specific loadouts
-# **Options**
-# 🔹 `<weapon>` Select weapon (supports autocomplete & partial word matching)
-# 🔹 `[build]` Specify build number
-# 🔹 `[visibility]` Show this response only to you, or publicly to everyone in the chat.

-# **Examples**
-# 🔸 **/gunsmiths search** weapon:`AK117`
-# 🔸 **/gunsmiths search** weapon:`Switchblade X9` build:`2` visibility:`Hidden`
-# 🔸 **/gunsmiths list** scope:`SMG`
-# 🔸 **/gunsmiths list** scope:`Meta — MP`
-# 🔸 **/dmz** weapon:`Fennec`
-# To see other commands, use the dropdown below or **`/help <cmd>`**

### `/colors`
View the colors extracted from your Discord profile and pick which one accents your panels

-# 🔹 `[source]` Read from your main profile, or your profile for this server

### `/timestamp`
Convert almost any date or time — including natural language — into a Discord timestamp that displays correctly in everyone's own timezone
-# **Options**
-# 🔹 `<datetime>` e.g. "tomorrow", "in 2 hours", "dec 25 at 9am", "19:30", "next monday"
-# 🔹 `[timezone]` Defaults to your saved `/settings` timezone
-# 🔹 `[style]` Pick one format, or leave blank for all formats
-# 🔹 `[view]` Embed or plain Text, one-off only
-# 🔹 `[visibility]` Show this response only to you, or publicly to everyone in the chat.

-# **Examples**
-# 🔸 **/colors** page:`Nameplate` source:`From Server Profile`
-# 🔸 **/timestamp** datetime:`this saturday 7pm` timezone:`Pacific Time`
-# 🔸 **/timestamp** datetime:`august 20` style:`Short Date (d)`
-# 🔸 **/timestamp** datetime:`in 45 minutes` view:`Text`
-# To see other commands, use the dropdown below or **`/help <cmd>`**

## <a:ServerSettings:1536468904996774008> **Preference Commands**
-# **Usage: `/cmd <required> [optional]`**

### `/settings`
Your own preferences, in two pages — **Visibility** (who sees your responses by default) and **Preferences** (timezone, timestamp style, accent style, and more)

### `/admin`
Where Dioreo answers **publicly** and where it stays **private**, for the whole server. Needs **Manage Server**.
-# Opens a four-page panel — **Overview · Channels · Roles · Commands**

-# **Rule order** · the most specific one wins
-# 🔹 Command **→** Role **→** Channel **→** the Overview default
-# 🔹 Threads follow their parent channel · if two roles disagree, **public wins**

-# **Setting it up**
-# 🔸 Pick a default on **Overview**, then hand-pick the few channels or roles that should differ
-# 🔸 Rules only make Dioreo **quieter** — Public *permits* a public answer, it never overrides someone's own `/settings`

-# **Worth knowing**
-# 🔸 Each menu takes **25 picks** — Discord's cap, and a sign you want a different default instead
-# 🔸 It hides the **answer**, not the command — to remove a command entirely, use **Server Settings → Integrations**

-# **Options** · both commands
-# 🔹 `[visibility]` Show this response only to you, or publicly to everyone in the chat.

-# **Examples**
-# 🔸 **/settings** visibility:`Public`
-# 🔸 **/admin** → **Overview** → *Switch default to Hidden*, then **Channels** → allow `#bot-spam`
-# 🔸 **/admin** → **Roles** → *Always public for these roles* → `@Moderator`
-# 🔸 **/admin** → **Commands** → mark `/colors` always-hidden, everything else stays public
-# To see other commands, use the dropdown below or **`/help <cmd>`**

## <a:ServerSettings:1536468904996774008> **Preference Commands**
-# **Usage: `/cmd <required> [optional]`**

### `/settings`
Your own preferences, in two pages — **Visibility** (who sees your responses by default) and **Preferences** (timezone, timestamp style, accent style, and more)

### `/admin`
Where Dioreo answers **publicly** and where it stays **private**, for the whole server. Needs **Manage Server**.
-# Opens a four-page panel — **Overview · Channels · Roles · Commands**

-# **Rule order** · the most specific one wins
-# 🔹 Command **→** Role **→** Channel **→** the Overview default
-# 🔹 Threads follow their parent channel · if two roles disagree, **public wins**

-# **Setting it up**
-# 🔸 Pick a default on **Overview**, then hand-pick the few channels or roles that should differ
-# 🔸 Rules only make Dioreo **quieter** — Public *permits* a public answer, it never overrides someone's own `/settings`

-# **Worth knowing**
-# 🔸 Each menu takes **25 picks** — Discord's cap, and a sign you want a different default instead
-# 🔸 It hides the **answer**, not the command — to remove a command entirely, use **Server Settings → Integrations**

-# **Options** · both commands
-# 🔹 `[visibility]` Show this response only to you, or publicly to everyone in the chat.

-# **Examples**
-# 🔸 **/settings** visibility:`Public`
-# 🔸 **/admin** → **Overview** → *Switch default to Hidden*, then **Channels** → allow `#bot-spam`
-# 🔸 **/admin** → **Roles** → *Always public for these roles* → `@Moderator`
-# 🔸 **/admin** → **Commands** → mark `/colors` always-hidden, everything else stays public
-# To see other commands, use the dropdown below or **`/help <cmd>`**

## <a:BotAccess:1540915865506160660> **Bot Admin Commands**
-# **Usage: `/cmd <required> [optional]`**

### `/bot analytics`
The bot's own usage, timing and health data, read from Discord instead of the VM
-# 🔹 `[page]` Jump directly to a page: `Health` · `Alerts` · `Changes` · `Usage` · `Timing`
### `/bot access`
The admin allowlist -- owner-only
-# 🔹 No options of its own
### `/bot hotpatch`
Reload changed files into the running bot without a restart -- owner-only
-# 🔹 `[pull]` git pull first (default: yes)
-# 🔹 `[dry_run]` Show the plan and change nothing
-# 🔹 `[file]` Limit to one changed file (default: everything the pull brought in)
### `/autobuild`
Read an MP loadout out of a Gunsmith screenshot and stage it for review — nothing is saved until it is confirmed
-# 🔹 `[screenshot]` The Gunsmith screenshot to read — or use `url` instead, never both
-# 🔹 `[url]` A link to the screenshot, when the image is already hosted somewhere
-# 🔹 `[category]` `AR` · `SMG` · `LMG` · `MARKSMAN` · `SNIPER` · `SHOTGUN` · `SECONDARIES` — looked up from the weapon, or asked for, if left blank
-# 🔹 `[badges]` `meta,best,top5,toxic` — blank inherits from an existing build of the same weapon
-# 🔹 `[retry_token]` Only for re-submitting an image after a Cloudinary upload failure
### `/manage`
The data-entry panel — seasonal info, draws, calendar, patch notes, loadouts, banners, admin access, announcements, and the next-season draft
-# 🔹 `[content]` Open a section directly: `Draws` · `Calendar` · `Patch Notes` · `MP Loadouts` · `DMZ Loadouts` · `Season: Titles & Deadlines` · `Season: Next Season Draft` · `Manage Admins` · `Announcement` · `Bulk Format Guide`
-# 🔹 On **Manage Admins**, Grant/Revoke are owner-only — every other whitelisted admin can still view the page and use Announcement.

-# **Options** · every command above
-# 🔹 `[visibility]` Show this response only to you, or publicly to everyone in the chat.

-# **Examples**
-# 🔸 **/bot analytics** page:`Usage` visibility:`Public` — share usage data in a channel
-# 🔸 **/autobuild** screenshot:`[upload]` category:`SMG` badges:`meta,top5`
-# 🔸 **/autobuild** url:`https://…` — when the screenshot is already hosted
-# 🔸 **/manage** content:`Patch Notes` — straight to the section, no clicking through
-# 🔸 **/manage** content:`Season: Next Season Draft` — stage next season without touching what is live

-# 💠 These are gated on **Dioreo's own admin whitelist**, not on a server permission — Manage Server does not grant them, and they are not registered for guild install at all.
-# To see other commands, use the dropdown below or **`/help <cmd>`**
